note: startOffsetDays/endOffsetDays are relative to the seed reference date (today unless SEED_AS_OF is set), which keeps the demo data close to the wall clock while remaining byte-identical for a given date. LR-0005 (EMP-009, PENDING, +10..+12) is the documented overlap scenario: POSTing another PENDING/APPROVED request for EMP-009 that intersects those dates must return 409 LEAVE_OVERLAP.
